subject: Re: Siemens / Skyline — host handoff & final slot for marketplace demo
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@si-siemens.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Siemens / Skyline — initial slot request + agenda

Marcus / Vanessa / Neha,

Thanks again for the quick cadence on this — Siemens is excited to run the joint marketplace demo with Redwood + Skyline next week. We want to lock a primary demo slot and a short technical dry run before the exec-facing session. High-level ask: please confirm who will be the live host vs. the fallback host, and confirm an AWS linchpin to join for the infra questions.

Proposed primary slots (CEST preferred):
- Tue, Oct 12 — 14:00–15:00 CEST
- Wed, Oct 13 — 09:00–10:00 CEST (APAC-friendly)

Fallback option in case of conflict: Thu, Oct 14 — 11:00–12:00 CEST

Attached is a short agenda and a preflight checklist (PDF/XLSX). Can we also book a 30-min dry run the day prior? Siemens will bring one SI engineer (Rakesh) and Liam as the engagement lead. We expect about 12 external attendees (sales + technical).

Agenda (short):
- 5m intros & objectives
- 20m end-to-end demo (Redwood hosted API + Skyline integration)
- 15m architecture Q&A (AWS networking, VPC peering, private deployment notes)
- 10m next steps / mutual action items

Please reply with confirmed slot and who will be the primary host from Redwood (we can do host handoff if needed).

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Enterprise Partnerships — Siemens Systems
liam.oconnor@si-siemens.com

Attachment: siemens-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: marketplace-preflight-runbook.xlsx (stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@si-siemens.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Siemens / Skyline — initial slot request + agenda

Hi Liam — great to hear Siemens is ready to go. Quick answers:
- Primary host: Marcus Lin (Redwood Solutions) — will handle product walkthrough and hand off to Skyline for SI-specific flows.
- Fallback host: Vanessa Ortiz will be on standby and can take over if we hit network/streaming issues.
- AWS linchpin: Anita Rao (copied below) is looped in — she’ll confirm infra availability.

Of the slots you suggested, Tue Oct 12 14:00 CEST works for us as the primary. We can do a 30-min dry run on Mon Oct 11 at 16:00 CEST (please confirm timezone mapping; that is Mon 09:00 PT). If that time doesn't work, Vanessa and I can offer Mon Oct 11 at 08:00 PT / 17:00 CEST.

I attached a slightly pared-down run order for our presenters; please let me know if we should tighten any segments.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415 555 0193

Attachment: redwood-presenter-order.pdf (1 page)

Subject: Re: Siemens / Skyline — initial slot request + agenda

Quick scheduling note — I have a standing all-hands on Tue morning CEST and won't be available until 15:30 CEST (sorry team). Marcus will cover the host duties during the 14:00 slot as planned. Neha: can you please take point on the attendee list and attendee invite (we had several internal folks wanting to join for the architecture section)?

Anita (AWS) — can you confirm if the proposed Tue 14:00 CEST slot will work for the AWS technical lead? Also, if there are any networking preflight requirements (VPC peering windows, firewall IPs), send them and we'll add to the runbook.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Thanks — Anita here from AWS partner engineering. Tue Oct 12 at 14:00 CEST is fine for the joint demo. A couple of preflight items from our side:
- Please provide the IP ranges for any test VMs or load generators you might bring; we can temporarily open the peering path.
- If you're using an AWS PrivateLink endpoint for the Skyline connector, confirm the endpoint name and region.

We recommend the dry run on Mon Oct 11 at 16:00 CEST — I'll join that session and bring one infra engineer to validate the VPC flows. I've uploaded a short checklist (I've added it to the shared Drive link Marcus referenced).

Anita Rao

- Vanessa: standby fallback host and confirm internal attendee list.
- Neha: send the finalized calendar invite + attendee RSVP list.
- Anita/AWS: validate VPC/PrivateLink during dry run. Provide any short-term firewall IPs to be added.
- Rakesh/Skyline: prepare 5-minute SI workflow demo (checkout flow + token exchange).
